brief: Inspect Underhill Hollow 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-095) and apply the loading reduction in MG-021 from the third day on events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, as required by MG-025. Ensure forced cooling is run continuously through the overnight period rather than allowing the thermostat to drop stages out, per MG-025. Vegetation and obstruction clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity if an outstanding defect exists, according to SOP-011. Record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period as specified in MG-021.
